schema.name: project_id
schema.label: Project Id
schema.description: One row per project. The project this spreader chart config belongs to. Unlike the non-native app, the Spreader Progress tab is gated on jfb_projects.is_spreader_active rather than on this row's presence, so a project can be flagged as a spreader job before its boundaries are uploaded.

schema.name: spreader_name
schema.label: Spreader Name
schema.description: The spreader rig's name, printed in the chart's title band (e.g. "Neenah").

schema.name: layer_title
schema.label: Layer Title
schema.description: Lift label printed in the chart's title band (e.g. "Layer 1").

schema.name: aerial_path
schema.label: Aerial Path
schema.description: Attachment fileId of the aerial image drawn behind the coverage. Optional -- the chart renders on a flat map colour without it, and unlike the placement grid a missing aerial never blocks the chart.

schema.name: aerial_original_name
schema.label: Aerial Original Name
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded aerial, shown in the settings tab so a PM can tell which image is loaded.

schema.name: aerial_storage_path
schema.label: Aerial Storage Path
schema.description: Platform storage path of the uploaded aerial, retained alongside its fileId for traceability.

schema.name: aerial_georef
schema.label: Aerial Georeference
schema.description: World bounds of aerial_path as {wL,wR,wT,wB} in the project CRS -- the same shape jfb_dredge_config and jfb_placement_config use.

schema.name: boundaries
schema.label: Subarea Boundaries
schema.description: Subarea polygons as [{area, rings}] in world coords, where rings are closed [x,y] rings. Coverage is HARD-CLIPPED to these, so placement is never charted outside the footprint. Empty/absent means no coverage can be derived at all.

schema.name: planned_lanes
schema.label: Planned Lanes
schema.description: The operators' lane plan as [{c0,c1,w}] -- first and last cell centres plus broadcast width, since lanes are straight uniform strips. Present means the plan-snap coverage model is used (clean lane-aligned edges matching the PM's hand drawing); absent falls back to the directional model.

schema.name: plan_cell_len_ft
schema.label: Plan Cell Length Ft
schema.description: Along-lane length of one planned cell, used by the plan-snap model to extend a lane's worked span by half a cell at each end.

schema.name: broadcast_ft
schema.label: Broadcast Ft
schema.description: Legacy symmetric broadcast width. Retained for parity with the non-native app; the directional model does not use it.

schema.name: min_step_tons
schema.label: Min Step Tons
schema.description: Minimum placed tons for a step to count as coverage. The spreader logs a step for every move including walking back to reposition, and those near-zero-tons steps must not paint coverage. 0 keeps every step.

schema.name: forward_throw_ft
schema.label: Forward Throw Ft
schema.description: How far material carries IN FRONT of the frontmost step, since the spinner throws forward. Nothing is ever painted behind the latest step.

schema.name: cross_extra_ft
schema.label: Cross Extra Ft
schema.description: Cross-lane spread beyond the step width/2 on each side.

schema.name: transition_ft
schema.label: Transition Ft
schema.description: Transition-zone band width. Edge lanes are inset from the boundary so no sand lands outside it, but they broadcast to the boundary, so the strip between the outer coverage and the boundary IS complete and gets filled within this band. 0 disables it.

schema.name: active
schema.label: Active
schema.description: Whether this config is live. An inactive row stops coverage being derived without deleting the uploaded boundaries, lane plan and aerial.
